goal_ru: После урока ты сможешь сказать, что самое лучшее, худшее, сложное — и почему.
can_do_en: I can talk about the best, the worst and the most difficult things and explain why.

words.example_en: It's the most popular game in my class.
the hardest problem I've ever seen
words.example_ru: самая трудная задача из всех, что я видел

words.en: in the world / in my class
words.example_en: the tallest building in the world
The final boss is the hardest.
My favourite character is the funniest.

grammar.title_ru: Превосходная степень: the -est / the most; the best, the worst
grammar.explain_ru: «Самый» — the + -est для коротких (the fastest, the biggest, the easiest) и the most для длинных (the most popular). Неправильные: good → the best, bad → the worst. Где «самый» — in (in the world, in my class), а «из всех, что…» — of (of all) или с ever: the best film I've ever seen (эту часть фразы дать целиком, Present Perfect — в m2).
grammar.explain_en: the + -est: the fastest, the biggest. the most + long adjective: the most popular. good → the best, bad → the worst. the best in the world / in my class.

examples.en: Minecraft is the most popular game in my class.
examples.ru: Minecraft — самая популярная игра в классе.

examples.en: The final level is the hardest, and the boss is the scariest.
examples.ru: Финальный уровень самый сложный, а босс — самый страшный.

examples.en: That was the worst film of the year.

grammar.tutor_notes_ru: Формат «топ-3» — ученик делает рейтинг (игры, фильмы, задачи олимпиад) и объясняет каждое место. Сравнить с прошлым уроком: faster than → the fastest.

topics_ru: самый сложный предмет и самая трудная задача
questions_en: What's the best game ever? Why?
What's the most difficult subject at school?
Who is the funniest person in your class?
What's the most overrated thing on the internet?
talk.tutor_notes_ru: Нейт оспаривает рейтинг («Number one? Really? It's the most overrated game in history.»). Ученик защищает с because.

tasks.text: It's ___ (good) game, but the last level is ___ (difficult) and the boss is ___ (big) in the series.

tasks.question: This is the most popular app ___ the world.

tasks.ask_ru: Послушай топ-3 без текста. Какая игра на первом месте и почему?
tasks.ask_en: Listen. What's number one and why?
tasks.audio: My top three games. Number three is a racing game — it's the fastest. Number two is a puzzle game — it's the most relaxing. And number one is a strategy game, because it's the most difficult and you need to think a lot.
tasks.question: Что на первом месте?

tasks.ask_ru: Сделай свой топ-3 (игры, фильмы, блогеры) и объясни каждое место.
tasks.ask_en: Give your top three and explain.
tasks.say: Your top three. Games, films, anything. And justify every place.
tasks.example: My top three games. Number three is Terraria — it's the most creative. Number two is Chess.com — it's the most useful for my brain. Number one is Factorio, because it's the most interesting game for programmers.

tasks.ask_ru: Три персонажа игры с характеристиками. Скажи, кто самый сильный, быстрый, умный.
tasks.ask_en: Who is the strongest, the fastest, the smartest?

image.prompt_en: Three game character cards side by side with stat bars: a big knight with the highest strength bar, a small ninja with the highest speed bar, a wizard with the highest intelligence bar, colourful game UI style, only bars and icons
image.alt_ru: Три карточки: рыцарь — самая высокая сила, ниндзя — самая высокая скорость, волшебник — самый высокий интеллект.

tasks.say: Compare the characters. Who would you choose?
tasks.example: The knight is the strongest, but he's the slowest. The ninja is the fastest. The wizard is the smartest. I'd choose the ninja because speed is the most important in this game.

homework.about_ru: Запиши голосом «самое-самое» своей недели: лучший момент, худший момент, самое трудное задание.

tasks.ask_ru: Лучшее, худшее и самое трудное за неделю.
tasks.ask_en: The best, the worst and the hardest thing this week.
tasks.say: Your week: the best moment, the worst moment, the hardest task.
tasks.example: The best moment was on Friday — we won a basketball match. The worst moment was the physics test. The hardest task was problem five at the olympiad.

pass.about_ru: Пройден, если верно 75% заданий и в топ-3 (t4) превосходная степень с the и объяснения.

review.note_ru: Сравнительная степень → превосходная; хобби и игры.
